create_dataframe_info: create a DataFrameInfo instance to summarize column names, dtypes, and memory usage of a DataFrame
create_series_info: create a SeriesInfo instance to summarize dtype, non-null count, and memory usage of a Series
summarize_dataframe_info: summarize a DataFrame's column summary, dtype counts, and memory usage via DataFrameInfo.render
summarize_series_info: summarize a Series's dtype, non-null count, and memory usage via SeriesInfo.render
build_dtype_counts_mapping: build a mapping of dtype names to their occurrence counts from a DataFrame's dtypes
